description.value: Co-op Mt. Lehman Food Store is part of the Otter Co-op network, a locally-owned cooperative serving communities across the Fraser Valley and beyond. Located in Abbotsford on Mount Lehman Road, this food store also includes a pharmacy. As a full-service grocery co-op, it would be a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.
